title: Reading a book aloud at age three

tellings.quote: I woke up one day when I was very young before I went to school walked into where my mother and her friend were visiting with each other and uh they were drinking coffee and I went over to a bookcase pulled a book out opened it up and started reading it to them and I had never spent a day in school cuz I was 3 years

plain: At three years old, before he had spent a day in school, Bob Maguire says he woke up one morning, walked in on his mother and her friend having coffee, pulled a book off the shelf and read it aloud to them. Maguire, introduced on the show as a CIA contractor, tells Michels this about his own childhood as a sign that he had unusual abilities from the start.
